newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL tin down 26 cents to 14.19 rgt/kg.
newsitem.headline: KL tin down 26 cents to 14.19 rgt/kg.

text.p: Malaysia's tin price fell 26 cents to 14.19 ringgit ($5.63) a kg in tandem with an overnight plunge on the London Metal Exchange (LME), traders said.
"The LME's fall prompted strong selling, but was some support at the lower level which saved the price from falling further," said a trader.

Initial offers overwhelmed bids by 126 tonnes to 29. Turnover shrunk to 91 tonnes from 122 on Tuesday. Buying at the lower level was seen from Japanese, European and local interests. The local premium over London rose to $60 from $45.
